IS IT POSSIBLE…

That there exists an ancient mystery that lies behind the events of the modern world?

An ancient object created over 2000 years ago and yet is altering the course of world history?

The secret behind the events of our age, the past, present, and the future?

Could it lie behind the greatest calamities of the modern world . . .

· The rise of Adolf Hitler and the Third Reich
· World War I
· The Holocaust
· World War II
· The spread of Marxism
· The rise of the Soviet Union
· Nuclear war
· The near end of the world
· What is yet to come, even a new world order
· And much, much more . . .

And where is it bringing the world?

Who is the dark angel?

And what are the unseen forces at work and moving behind the events of the modern world?

In what may be his most stunning and monumental book yet, The Altar of Pergamon: The Mystery of the Dark Angel and the Future of the World, #1 New York Times Bestselling Author Jonathan Cahn opens up the ancient mystery that has affected and is affecting everyone on earth . . . even you!

For the first time in years, Cahn reveals the mystery through a story, the spellbinding account of Ariel Herzog, a skeptic known for dismantling the claims of the supernatural, but who receives a cryptic page of a secret book. The page opens up an ancient mystery.

The mystery will lead Herzog and an unlikely ally, Lara Winter, to undertake a journey that will span the globe to unlock the mystery, page by page, revelation by revelation. The journey will take them from New York City to Istanbul, to Berlin, to Eastern Europe, to Moscow, New Mexico, Havana, Jerusalem, and beyond. In each place, they will encounter a mysterious agent connected to the mystery holding the keys to unlock the next secret and piece of the puzzle.

But they are not alone. They will find themselves watched, tracked, and pursued by the members of a dark organization who have guarded the mystery from ancient times. And those who draw too close to unlocking its secret do so at the risk or cost of their lives.

The Altar of Pergamon will reveal the Visitor, the Man in the Bazaar, the Dark Kingdom, the Monster's Birth, the Guardians of the Throne, the Wizard, the Hall of Mirrors, the Stranger on the Train, the Dark Priesthood, the Ancient Matrix, the Black Gate, the Winged Creature, the Unholy of Holies, the Lightning of the Gods, the Woman and the Beast, What Was and Is to Come, the End of All Things, and much, much more.

It may sound like a thriller… a fantasy… something out of an Indiana Jones adventure… Lord of the Rings… or the DaVinci Code . . .

But The Altar of Pergamon is different from all of these …

Because the mystery it reveals is not fiction

It's real…

It will change the way you see the world.

It has already altered the course of world history… and maybe even your life.

It is the mystery on which the future of the world hangs in the balance.

And your future may depend on it.

The Altar of Pergamon – The Mystery of the Dark Angel and the Future of the World – the book you can't afford not to read!
